5078-5642-8346.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

643-2638-3510-6705.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-2638-3510-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

1170-1329-4808-8201.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Black Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4311-5078-5223-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

147-997-3085.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-997-3085.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

132-1379-3053-4687.easyPrerequisites:
Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
132-1379-3053-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.
132-1379-3053-4687.notes: This combo only produces infinite mana if there are at least four basic land types among lands you control.

1170-3698-4908-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3698-4908-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

757-1446-5087-7798.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-1446-5087-7798.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Viral Drake to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Natural Emergence, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

2292-2946-3220-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2292-2946-3220-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-2292-4605-5542-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6145.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Passageway Seer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Passageway Seer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Passageway Seer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Passageway Seer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Passageway Seer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6145.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1368-3755-4359-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3755-4359-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1394-2060-3129-4050-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Primal Vigor.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Primal Vigor.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1115-1308-1563-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1510-4574-5256-5849.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

1479-2841-4862-6155.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-4862-6155.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Omnath trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-628-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
413-628-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
413-628-6972.notes: If the creature being used starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

252-2034-2073--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

1247-3918-4087.description:
Activate Trazyn using Lavabrink Floodgates's ability by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2557-5436-5742-5743.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2733-4050-4772-5043.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

127-565-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
127-565-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Cast Imps' Taunt with buyback by paying {4}{B}, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve Imps' Taunt, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

1651-2410-4777.notablePrerequisites:
Silver Myr and Myr Galvanizer do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional Myr artifact creatures.
1651-2410-4777.description:
Activate Silver Myr by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two other Myr artifact creatures you control, untapping Myr Galvanizer.
Repeat.
If you control another Myr that can tap to produce at least {1}, this combo nets infinite mana.

184-3809-4682.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
184-3809-4682.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

261-859-1424.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Lurking Roper.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
261-859-1424.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, Suture Priest's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1242-1656-4170.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1242-1656-4170.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may instead use Fain's third ability to create infinite Inklings, then use Fain's fourth ability to untap Necrotic Ooze.
You then can also use Fain's first ability to get infinite +1/+1 counters.

1719-3756-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
1719-3756-4222.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat any number of times.

293-1209-1946-2292-2842-2890-2904-4892.description:
Cast Flash by paying {1}{U}, putting Protean Hulk from your hand onto the battlefield and sacrificing it.
Protean Hulk triggers, searching your library for Viscera Seer, Blood Artist, Cephalid Illusionist, and Nomads en-Kor and putting them onto the battlefield.
Activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
If you mill Narcomoeba.
Nacromoeba triggers,  putting it onto the battlefield from graveyard.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Nacromoeba.
Blood Artist trigger, causing target player to lose 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer trigger, scrying one.
If you mill Kozilek, shuffle your graveyard into your library.
Repeat from step 3.

978-3607-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing River Kelpie.
River Kelpie's persist triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
River Kelpie enters the battlefield, causing you to draw.
Resolve the Spawning Pit trigger, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.
